game.core.world.fact.summary: Hospitality is a widely respected settlement custom in the peaceful era. Travelers are expected to contribute when they can, while inns, shrines, village halls, and generous households provide warmth, news, and a place to sleep. A remembered kindness can travel farther than a formal introduction.
